subject: DPA wrap-up: roles, telemetry windows, and embeddings
messages:
From: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@acme.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: legal@acme.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA questions — roles and telemetry for embeddings

Marissa,

Thanks for sending the initial DPA draft. A few quick items from our side before counsel redlines:

- Role definitions: our privacy team needs an explicit statement about when Acme is controller vs when Redwood is controller. In particular, embeddings derived from our content — are those treated as "Customer Data" under the agreement, or is Redwood able to treat them as service data?
- Telemetry/logs: we need clarity on what logs Redwood retains, for how long, and whether they contain unredacted customer identifiers. Our risk team would prefer a 30-day cap on raw telemetry, with aggregated service metrics exempted.
- Subprocessors: please provide your current subprocessors list and confirm 30 days notice for additions (or a link to a published list).
- Training use: please confirm that embeddings or other Customer Data will not be used to train models unless we opt in.

Can you confirm these points and send any redline you propose? We may need to run this through procurement for the final sign-off and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortega
Senior Counsel — Privacy
Acme Corp.

Attachment: none

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@acme.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA questions — roles and telemetry for embeddings

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list. High-level answers and proposal below; attaching a redline that captures these edits: DPA_Redline_v3.docx and our current subprocessors list Subprocessors_2027Q2.csv.

- Roles: Redwood will be Processor for customer-provided content and derived artifacts (including embeddings) when customers use Redwood hosted inference. We are willing to add a narrow clause clarifying that Redwood may act as Controller only for telemetry/operational metrics collected solely for Redwood's internal compliance and billing (subject to the telemetry retention limits below).

- Embeddings & training: Redwood does not use Customer Data or customer-provided embeddings to train models (no training use) unless the customer explicitly opts in. We will add that as a covenant in the DPA.

- Telemetry/logs: we can agree to raw telemetry retention up to 90 days for operational troubleshooting by default, with an option to reduce to 30 days on a per-customer basis. However, we can offer a compromise: 30 days for identifiable/request-level logs (request content, full KV cache dumps), and up to 180 days for aggregated, pseudonymized metrics used for capacity planning and SLA verification. When feasible we will pseudonymize identifiers within 7 days.

- Subprocessors: attached list is current. We provide 30 days notice for additions; we can add a published list URL and a governance contact.

If those concessions look acceptable we can incorporate Samantha's counsel redlines and generate a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Next steps: Laura — can you confirm we can accept the 30-day identifiable log limit with the aggregated metrics carve-out? Vivek — please confirm the "no training" language is acceptable from a product/ops perspective.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_Redline_v3.docx (redline), Subprocessors_2027Q2.csv (list)

From: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@acme.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: legal@acme.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA questions — roles and telemetry for embeddings

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick reply and the redline. A couple follow-ups from our counsel:

- Our privacy team insists on a firm 30-day cap for raw request-level telemetry; aggregated metrics are acceptable to retain longer but must be pseudonymized (can't contain Acme identifiers).
- The "controller for telemetry" line feels risky. If Redwood needs an exception for billing/operational reconciliation please limit it to invoicing metadata only and explicitly exclude any content-derived artifacts.
- Please add a direct clause that embeddings are Customer Data and won't be used for training without explicit opt-in.

Procurement has asked that we receive the final DocuSign envelope so they can track execution. Their contact is procurement@acme.com. If you can update the redline to make the raw telemetry 30 days and include the explicit embedding/training clause we can circulate internally and sign.

Samantha

Attachment: Acme_DPA_Redlines_from_Counsel.pdf (redlines noted inline)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme DPA — acceptability check and sign-off question

Team — quick internal note before I push a final to Acme:

- Recommendation: accept 30-day raw telemetry retention (request-level logs) with an explicit aggregated/pseudonymized metrics carve-out (up to 180 days) for SLA/billing. We will add the 7-day pseudonymization timing. This aligns with our product tooling and reduces sales friction.
- Embeddings: add a one-sentence covenant that embeddings derived from customer inputs are Customer Data and will not be used for training unless the customer opts in (marketing/product have confirmed this is safe).
- Roles: remove the broad "Redwood may be Controller" phrasing and replace with the narrow "controller limited to invoicing metadata and operational reconciliation" clause.

Rafael — can you coordinate with finance/procurement to make sure the DocuSign envelope routing includes procurement@acme.com and legal@acme.com? I'll update the redline and send.

If no objections by 1pm PT I'll finalize and send the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa

(Internal only)

From: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@acme.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA questions — roles, telemetry, and embeddings — signed

Marissa,

Got it — procurement and counsel reviewed the updated redline and we signed via DocuSign. Envelope ID: 000123. Please confirm you have the executed copy and that the Subprocessors CSV will be posted to the published list URL you mentioned.

Thanks for the collaborative process. Looking forward to onboarding.

Samantha Ortega
Senior Counsel — Privacy
Acme Corp.

Attachments: DocuSignEnvelope_000123.pdf (executed DPA)
